items.name: R-ArcGIS-LSM_ToolPack
items.description: This tool is to develop an easy-to-use tool package called Landslide Susceptibility Mapping Tool Pack (LSM Tool Pack) for producing landslide susceptibility maps based on integrating R with ArcMap Software. The proposed tool contains 5 main modules namely: (1) Data Preparation (DP), (2) Feature (Factor) Selection (FS), (3) Logistic Regression (LR), (4) Random Forest (RF), (5) Performance Evaluation (PE) and (6) Create Raster Stack (Multi-Bands).
